upstream.commercial_descendants: GMX V2 totalBorrowing is a running sum of applyFactor(size, factor) updated by unsigned subtract-then-add. Treating it as signed (next-prev) lets a prev contribution larger than the total succeed (15000000 vs revert). Nested floor of applyFactor raises the total versus fused (nextProd-prevProd)/FLOAT. FLOAT is 1e30 on chain; this clone uses 1e6.
